notes: Two routes end at Abu Hurayra: one through Tawus, one («وأبي الزناد، عن الأعرج») through Abu al-Zinad and al-A'raj; the text writes Abu Hurayra twice, so the routes are written in full with no shared tail
The reading of «عن أبي هريرة، وأبي الزناد» as two routes rather than two co-transmitters of Tawus is the closest reading; the sentence is compressed
